body: my weathered bundle entry says the crop trial workers brushed off rust-colored grit. the chickens stopped moving before the back road closed.
title: weathered bundle note — late wednesday
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the rust-colored grit while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.

title: Names beneath the soil
body: I wrote down who we buried because the visitors collecting the numbers had counted tents instead of people. They asked for the notebook and left me the page for supplies. I kept this page folded under the coffee tin.
rival_reading: The agricultural trial may have caused the disorder that forced improvised decisions.
gloss: A witness records a failed evacuation count or route.
